description: All metrics emitted by kvcache-event-subscriber. Dual-written via dashlog (Prometheus) and PAI-EAS realtime_metrics (SLS). Tags are Prometheus labels / PAI-EAS tag keys.

eas_reporting.histogram_semantics: aggregated into _avg and _max suffixes per flush window

sources.MetricsReporter: Async main-path flush. Reads a BatchTelemetry per event; emits per-stage histograms, e2e latency, aggregate counters, and (for dropped batches) a drop-count counter plus partial-stage histograms tagged with drop_reason.
sources.lifecycle: Synchronous point-event helpers in subscriber.metrics.lifecycle (report_engine_probe, report_heartbeat, report_shutdown, report_zmq_message, ...). Called directly from health, kvcm, and adapter code paths.

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_decode_ms

tags.drop_reason: epoch_changed | send_failed | filtered_empty | engine_not_ready | generation_reset | (absent on success)

metrics.description: Latency of decoding a ZMQ frame into KV events (incremental, vLLM adapter) or msgpack-decoding a fetched snapshot payload (snapshot). Emitted on every submitted telemetry that reached this stage; drop_reason tag is present when the batch was ultimately dropped.

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_replay_fetch_ms
metrics.description: Latency of fetching replay batches from the engine after a sequence gap

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_snapshot_fetch_ms

tags.drop_reason: fetch_failed | generation_reset | empty_snapshot | schema_mismatch | decode_failed | engine_not_ready | epoch_changed | send_failed | (absent on success)

metrics.description: Latency of the gRPC round-trip for a full KV cache snapshot. Emitted on every poll including fetch_failed drops (the stage span is closed before the drop is recorded).

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_snapshot_build_ms

tags.drop_reason: generation_reset | engine_not_ready | epoch_changed | send_failed | (absent on success)

metrics.description: Latency of building a BlockSnapshot event from a fetched snapshot response. Not emitted on drops that occur before this stage (fetch_failed, empty_snapshot, schema_mismatch, decode_failed, first generation_reset check).

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_expand_ms
metrics.description: Latency of expanding KV events or snapshot blocks into the KVCM reportEvent wire payload (serialization). Marked inside report_kv_events and report_snapshot after the expand step completes.

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_queue_wait_ms
metrics.description: Time a batch spends waiting in the internal producer/consumer queue

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_engine_gate_wait_ms
metrics.description: Time waiting for the engine health coordinator to grant a sendable epoch

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_block_filter_ms
metrics.description: Time spent filtering redundant block removals before sending

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_stage_kvcm_send_ms
metrics.description: Time spent on the HTTP round-trip to KVCM (POST reportEvent and response handling). Serialization cost is excluded (covered by expand). Only emitted on successful send.

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_event_e2e_latency_ms
metrics.description: End-to-end latency from event receipt to the pipeline terminal action (KVCM send for both incremental and snapshot). Only emitted on successful telemetry; dropped batches expose their partial timeline through the individual kv_stage_*_ms histograms with drop_reason tag.

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_stored_block_hash_count
metrics.description: Number of block hashes forwarded as BLOCK_ADD events per batch

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_removed_block_hash_count
metrics.description: Number of block hashes forwarded as BLOCK_DELETE events per batch

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_snapshot_block_count
metrics.description: Blocks contained in full KV cache snapshots forwarded to KVCM per successful send

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_zmq_sequence_gap_count
metrics.description: Sequence gaps detected in the ZMQ pub stream, attributed to the replay batch that exposed the gap

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_zmq_missed_message_count
metrics.description: Messages missed across sequence gaps, attributed to the replay batch that exposed the gap

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kv_batch_drop_count

tags.reason: epoch_changed | send_failed | filtered_empty | engine_not_ready | fetch_failed | generation_reset | empty_snapshot | schema_mismatch | decode_failed

metrics.description: Batches or polls dropped before reaching downstream. Incremental reasons: epoch_changed, send_failed, filtered_empty (all events removed by the block filter; benign no-op, not a failure), engine_not_ready. Snapshot reasons: fetch_failed (gRPC error), generation_reset (poll spanned a reset_generation_state call), empty_snapshot (engine returned no raw snapshot payload), schema_mismatch (msgpack payload failed schema validation), decode_failed (msgpack payload could not be decoded), engine_not_ready, epoch_changed, send_failed. Emitted once per submitted dropped BatchTelemetry.

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_zmq_received_message_count
metrics.description: Total ZMQ pub messages received from the engine. Background throughput counter; not tied to any specific batch.

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kvcm_heartbeat_count
metrics.description: Heartbeat reports to KVCM (use rate() for heartbeat QPS, group by status)

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kvcm_registration_recovery_count
metrics.description: Number of times KVCM registration recovered after a failure

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_kvcm_registration_transition_count
metrics.description: KVCM registration state transitions

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_engine_health_probe_count
metrics.description: Engine health probe outcomes, labeled by result

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_engine_health_probe_latency_ms
metrics.description: Engine health probe latency, labeled by result

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_full_snapshot_payload_bytes

tags.drop_reason: generation_reset | empty_snapshot | schema_mismatch | decode_failed | engine_not_ready | epoch_changed | send_failed | (absent on success)

metrics.description: Serialized protobuf response size for each full KV cache snapshot fetch that produced a response. Emitted on success and on every post-fetch drop so an empty payload (0 bytes) is observable as a real 0 rather than a missing datapoint. Not emitted on fetch_failed drops (no response object exists).

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_engine_health_state_transition_count
metrics.description: Engine health state machine transitions

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_subscriber_phase_transition_count
metrics.description: Subscriber phase transitions reported to DashServing

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_dashserving_heartbeat_count
metrics.description: DashServing state heartbeat outcomes (use rate() for QPS, group by status)

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_dashserving_state_report_count
metrics.description: State report outcomes to DashServing, labeled by state and result

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_dashserving_state_report_latency_ms
metrics.description: State report latency to DashServing, labeled by state and result

metrics.name: kvcache_subscriber_subscriber_shutdown_count
metrics.description: Shutdown/HostDown emission outcomes
